description: This file contains integration tests for the Delete Catalog Item API endpoint, verifying behavior with valid and invalid IDs when accessed by an admin user.

classes.name: DeleteCatalogItemEndpointTest
classes.description: Contains integration tests for the DELETE catalog item API endpoint, ensuring correct responses for valid and invalid IDs.

methods.name: ReturnsSuccessGivenValidIdAndAdminUserToken
methods.description: Tests that deleting an existing catalog item with valid admin token returns a success response.

methods.name: ReturnsNotFoundGivenInvalidIdAndAdminUserToken
methods.description: Tests that deleting a non-existent catalog item returns a 404 Not Found response.
